name: Normal Operational Baseline
description: Standard seasonal consumption with routine supply cycles and no active disaster alerts.

name: Monsoon Flooding & Waterborne Surge
description: Severe cloudburst causing Flash floods in Rayagada and Kalahandi river basins. Unprecedented surge in diarrheal cases, snakebites, and secondary bacterial infections.

name: Post-Monsoon Vector Outbreak
description: Stagnant floodwater accelerates Anopheles breeding in forested tribal belts. Acute surge in falciparum malaria and hyperpyrexia.

name: Pre-Monsoon Extreme Heat Emergency
description: Peak summer temperatures exceeding 45.8°C across Kalahandi and Nabarangpur plains, causing severe dehydration and heatstroke.

name: Winter Viral Respiratory Cluster
description: Cold spell in high-altitude Lamtaput and Thuamul Rampur ridges triggering acute bronchiolitis and secondary pneumonia.
